purpose: Prospective paired SUMO validation of the unchanged recovery gate under out-of-training-support interactions, compound actuator mismatch and perception error.

comparator_scope.mps_shared: V35 behavior-matched MPS adapter, not a full external MPS reproduction
comparator_scope.mamps_shared: V35 behavior-matched MAMPS adapter, not a full external MAMPS reproduction
comparator_scope.bank_performance: fixed proposed buffered recovery gate and sole primary learned method

seed_design.sampling: three disjoint deterministic hash streams fixed before execution
seed_design.pairing: Each initial is crossed with all 3 plants, all 3 perceptions and all 13 methods.

scenario_contract.sumo_topology: existing fixed-route three-actor two-to-one merge; branches [0,1,0]
scenario_contract.training_support_reference: Existing nominal/dense training used speeds 8--17 m/s, positions -70--110 m, and a 30--45 m same-route lead gap.

ood_axes.compressed_simultaneous: 8.5--12 m same-route gap and nearly simultaneous merge arrival
ood_axes.cross_route_priority_flip: cross-route actor deterministically reaches the conflict first
ood_axes.rear_end_merge_wave: large follower/leader closing-speed interaction concurrent with merge conflict

scenario_contract.preflight_rule: Every frozen state must insert exactly and initialize the common baseline. Any failure invalidates the protocol; the seed may not be replaced.

plant_contract.innovation: same bounded uniform radius-0.1 tape for every paired method and factor cell of an initial
plant_contract.guarantee_scope: All three compound plants violate the unchanged gate's declared lag_strong class. Results are empirical robustness evidence and inherit no V34/V35 physical certificate.

perception_contract.fairness: Within a condition, baseline and every learned gate receive the identical perturbed position/speed stream and exact executed previous command.
perception_contract.truth_firewall: True SUMO state is used only by physics, collision/geometry checks and post-run audit; it is unavailable to all controllers.
perception_contract.certificate_scope: The existing exact-state stopping certificate is not claimed under biased, stale or dropped observations.

primary_estimands.population: Equal-weight mixture of the three frozen OOD regime generators; within each initial, equal weight over the nine plant/perception cells.
primary_estimands.methods: bank_performance for each fixed model versus the one paired recovery baseline
primary_estimands.failure_risk_difference: theta_F(model)=E[F_bank(model)-F_baseline], paired and aggregated first within initial_id
primary_estimands.interpretation: Positive theta_L favors the gate; nonpositive theta_F favors the gate. These are deployment-mixture estimands, not a conditional-on-completion analysis.

secondary_estimands: completion and failure components by regime, plant and perception cell
adoption rate, fallback fraction, switch count and longest consecutive learned segment
descriptive conditional harm among adopted episodes with denominator reported
per-vehicle capped finish, command variation, jerk and route-geometry violations
controller call p50/p95/max, calls above 500 ms and total controller time
effect modification relative to clean perception and mild compound mismatch
exact fallback-command identity against the common recovery baseline

inference.independent_unit: initial_id; the 9 factor cells and 13 methods are repeated paired measures
inference.aggregation: first average paired contrasts within initial, then equal-weight the three regimes
inference.intervals: stratified paired cluster bootstrap resampling initials within regime
inference.primary_tests: One-sided centered cluster-bootstrap margin tests at failure difference 0.01 and failure-penalized cost gain 0, with Holm familywise adjustment across three models.
inference.displayed_intervals: Unadjusted one-sided percentile intervals, descriptive only
inference.degenerate_rule: Zero within-stratum/stratified-bootstrap variance, zero cluster variance, or no nonzero failure contrast is untestable and fails closed; zero observed discordance is not a rare-event population certificate.
inference.multiplicity: Holm familywise alpha 0.05 across the three fixed models, separately per primary estimand
inference.no_pseudoreplication: 22,464 SUMO runs are not treated as independent samples

indicator_is_one_if_any: timeout or any vehicle incomplete at the 25 s horizon
non-finite command, state, trace or registered metric
executed command violates fixed acceleration or slew limits
episode_failure.failed_run_cost_rule: Use the prespecified capped finish/variation plus 25 s failure penalty.

study_invalid_if_any: missing/duplicate run or incomplete exact 22,464-run coverage
source, model, plan, tape, pairing, replay or receipt hash mismatch
controller access to true rather than frozen perturbed observation
initial state cannot be inserted exactly or common baseline cannot initialize
method-specific physical innovation or perception tape
validity_and_acceptance.fallback_integrity_required: Every recorded fallback decision must exactly equal an independently replayed common recovery-baseline command under the same observation and command history.
claim_passes_only_if: all validity and fallback-integrity checks pass
for every fixed model, the nondegenerate one-sided theta_F < 0.01 margin test passes after Holm adjustment
for every fixed model, the nondegenerate one-sided theta_L > 0 margin test passes after Holm adjustment

scope.applies_to: Three longitudinal actors on the existing fixed-route SUMO merge, the three frozen learned model sets, the unchanged V35 rules and exactly the declared generators.
does_not_establish: lane-changing, vision, arbitrary traffic density or real-vehicle validity
formal safety under compound mismatch or perception error
population risk certification or superiority outside the frozen mixture
a new MARL training algorithm or equilibrium guarantee

execution_contract.implementation_status: A separate additive executor and independent auditor are required before launch.
required_before_launch: commit this plan builder, tests and protocol document
freeze plan.json exclusively before executing any case
bind complete transitive source, runtime, SUMO and model hashes
use acknowledged native worker identities and durable per-block stores
persist a run before checking it; summarize only after successful full exit and replay
execution_contract.resume_rule: Never overwrite or outcome-selectively restart; use a separately frozen additive recovery plan.
